operations.text: You remain responsible for every act or omission, with respect to the Information, of any person to whom you disclose it, including an Authorized Recipient, as though it were your own.

runs.text: You will not input, upload, or otherwise submit the Information to any artificial intelligence, machine learning, or large language model service unless the provider of that service is contractually prohibited from retaining the Information beyond the session in which you submit it and from using it to train, fine-tune, or improve any model.

operations.comment: New. Not required by 11 CCR 7053; added because requesters routinely paste data into consumer AI tools that retain inputs. Delete if too aggressive for the relationship.
Added 2(c) (post-disclosure minor deletion duty), 7(b) (no-objection waiver) and 7(c) (rights-request duty). Without them these arguably lapse if we terminate under 9(b).
